Markets.title: US stock: S&P 500 ends lower as investors weigh data, Middle East tensions
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 fell from its peak as weaker retail sales and Middle East tensions caused investors to exercise caution. Energy stocks rose alongside oil prices, while Applied Materials slumped and dragged down AI-related shares.

Markets.title: Nvidia’s $500 billion plan envelops Wall Street in its AI frenzy
Markets.summary: Nvidia has partnered with major financial institutions on a $500 billion financing plan to help AI startups acquire computing chips. This strategy aims to meet the surging global demand for artificial intelligence hardware and digital infrastructure.

Markets.title: How a $900 million bet on SpaceX turned 100x into $94 billion for Alphabet
Markets.summary: Alphabet's early $900 million investment in SpaceX has grown by 100 times to be worth approximately $94 billion. This massive return makes Alphabet the largest institutional shareholder in the rocket company.

Markets.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
Markets.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a 29.33% increase in revenue to ₹11,337 crore and a 35.22% rise in gross profit to ₹1,521 crore for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. Driven by record revenues and strong execution, the company also declared two interim dividends.

Markets.title: Global Markets: Hotter Europe isn't cooling investor fervor for stocks
Markets.summary: Despite costly summer heatwaves impacting European industries like agriculture and tourism, stock exchanges in Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid, and Milan hit all-time highs in August. These record highs in Europe align with recent record-setting indexes on Wall Street.

Markets.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
Markets.summary: Accel India IV sold a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company on August 13, 2026, by offloading 2 crore equity shares through open market deals. This transaction reduced the Mauritius-based investor's holding in the home services platform to 4.84 percent.

Geo-Political.title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
Geo-Political.summary: Five years after the Taliban took control of Afghanistan, women report that their lives are unrecognizable due to severe restrictions. They face public floggings, job losses, and dangerous barriers to accessing healthcare.

Geo-Political.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
Geo-Political.summary: BBC's Top Comment podcast uncovered a network of Instagram accounts glamourising the swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence. These profiles are providing paid advice to help migrants cross into the Spanish enclave.

Geo-Political.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
Geo-Political.summary: Activists attempted to deliver aid to two Palestinian families trapped inside their West Bank homes. The families have been besieged by Israeli settlers for several days.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented rain in Japan has killed eight people and left over 20,000 households without power. The severe storm also stranded 7,000 travelers at Tokyo's Narita airport.

Geo-Political.title: Builders unearth €9m gold stash sealed in walls of Belgian property
Geo-Political.summary: Construction workers in Belgium discovered nine million euros in gold hidden inside the walls of a cellar. The stash was found while the workers were drilling to lay sewage pipes.

Geo-Political.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
Geo-Political.summary: Police in Brazil arrested a man after recovering eight stolen artworks by French artist Henri Matisse in greater São Paulo. The recovered pieces were found inside a residential home during the police operation.

AI & Tech.summary: The author tested asking ChatGPT for WordPress SaaS course recommendations and discovered their own unpaid course appeared as the top result. This experiment highlights the growing shift toward AI optimization (AIO) alongside traditional SEO for generating organic traffic.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation cooled marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel and power inflation moderated to 20.05% from 27.41% in June. Meanwhile, inflation in primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations and could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, compounded by risks from elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's sovereign credit rating at BBB- for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong growth outlook and forecasts a 6.4% GDP growth rate. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also notes that India's primary challenge is ensuring workforce employability rather than simply creating jobs.

India.title: Green India Mission Fell Short By 98% In Increasing Forest Cover: CAG
India.summary: A recent CAG report revealed that the Green India Mission fell short of its forest cover expansion target by 97.57 percent between 2015 and 2025. The initiative increased forest cover by only 0.03 million hectares against the intended goal of 1.4 million hectares.

India.title: Man Arrested For Allegedly Threatening To Kill Hemant Soren
India.summary: Police arrested a man on Friday for allegedly threatening to kill Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren. The threat was made during protests in Ranchi regarding alleged irregularities in recruitment examinations.

India.title: Census 2027 To Collect Mobile, Aadhaar, Bank Account Details
India.summary: The upcoming Census 2027 will collect respondents' mobile, Aadhaar, and bank account details. Questionnaires from all previous Censuses between 1872 and 2011 did not ask for this information.

India.title: Homoeopaths Can't Practice Other System Of Medicine: Homoeopathy Panel
India.summary: Homoeopaths are prohibited from practicing any medical system other than homoeopathy under current regulations. However, an exception to this rule is made for practitioners working under government programs.

India.title: AI Must Not Replace Human Consciousness: Allahabad High Court Judge
India.summary: An Allahabad High Court judge stated that artificial intelligence must not replace human consciousness. He warned that excessive reliance on AI could weaken essential human abilities.

India.title: UGC-NET 2026 Answer Key To Be Released On August 16: Testing Agency
India.summary: The National Testing Agency will release the UGC-NET 2026 provisional answer keys on August 16. The provisional answer keys for the CSIR-NET, ICAR AIEEA (PG), and AICE (PhD) 2026 exams will also be published on the same day.

General.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row, found dead
General.summary: Jason Arday, a former Cambridge professor who was recently at the centre of a plagiarism row, was found dead in south London on Friday afternoon. Emergency services stated that a man was discovered unresponsive at an address in Battersea.
